{{Quote|Imperial Knights! Save your Emperor!|Mohrgan Fel, commanding the Imperial Knight and their two companions|<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 1: Broken, Part 1" />}}
A '''Human''' who wore their long [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair in a ponytail was an [[Imperial Knight]] serving [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]] in [[130 ABY]]. After Fel's forces [[Battle of Caamas|defeated]] the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and won the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the [[One Sith|Sith]] allies of the Empire betrayed the Emperor. When Fel caught wind of an impending [[Death/Legends|murder]] attempt on him by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]], he fled into [[Empire-in-exile|exile]] and sent the brown-haired individual and three other Imperial Knights against Krayt to distract the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. The Dark Lord arrived at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on the Empire's [[Planet/Legends|throneworld]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Attack on Emperor Fel|slew]] all four Knights before proclaiming himself the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They'll expect me&mdash;and a contingent of Imperial Knights&mdash;to appear at the council&hellip;''"<br />"''I'll lead them&mdash;and your double.|Roan and Mohrgan Fel|<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 8: Allies" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] with long [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair worn worn in a ponytail was an [[Imperial Knight]] in [[130 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 8: Allies" /> The Imperial Knights were an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] serving [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the brown-haired individual participated in a ruse devised by Fel against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]. Following [[Battle of Caamas|the conclusion]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], Fel was informed by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] that the [[One Sith|Sith]] who had helped his Empire defeat the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and win the war were intent on betraying him. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt planned to [[Death/Legends|murder]] Fel and seize the Imperial throne at an upcoming meeting of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]], and Fel accordingly fled the Imperial [[Planet/Legends|throneworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Before doing so, he arranged for [[Roan Fel's double|his double]] to meet with Krayt in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] and buy him [[Time/Legends|time]] to escape.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 8: Allies" />

[[Mohrgan Fel]], an Imperial Knight and the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] cousin, volunteered to lead the brown-haired Knight and [[Unidentified Imperial Knight 1|two]] [[Unidentified short-haired Imperial Knight|others]] against Krayt in order to further the deception. The brown-haired Knight stood with their three brethren and surrounded the decoy Emperor<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 8: Allies" /> as he and the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] discussed the consequences of the war being over. Krayt arrived with [[Darth Maladi|three]] [[Darth Nihl|of]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|his]] fellow [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and demanded Fel's life, which prompted Mohrgan to call on the Knights to protect their Emperor. Krayt drew [[Jar'Kai/Legends|two]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and quickly [[Attack on Emperor Fel|killed]] the four Knights despite their attempts at a defense. He then struck down the decoy Emperor and proclaimed himself the Emperor of a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Empire]]. Fel and the remaining Imperial Knights were forced into [[Empire-in-exile|exile]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 1: Broken, Part 1" /><ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 8: Allies" />

==Powers and abilities==
The brown-haired Human was a member of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 1: Broken, Part 1" /> an organization whose membership was limited to those who displayed potential in using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Imperial Knights were considered to be among the most talented and dangerous Force-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" /> The Imperial Knights did not participate in the Sith&ndash;Imperial War at their Emperor's behest, but the brown-haired Knight battled a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] following the war's conclusion. Darth Krayt easily dispatched them and three other Imperial Knights with his dual lightsabers.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 8: Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The brown-haired Imperial Knight was one introduced in [[Legacy (2006) 1|the first issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], and released in [[June]] [[2006]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 1: Broken, Part 1" />
